release_notes:
Offline series management with dedicated episode navigation, playback controls, remote dynamic environment config, and Google Play DEX code optimization.

Added
- Dedicated Series Details screen for offline downloads with grouped episodes and bulk download actions
- Next and Previous episode playback controls for both streaming and offline downloaded media
- Auto-play next movie in downloads when finishing offline movie playback
- Remote environment configuration (.env) hydrated dynamically from version.json without needing app rebuilds
- Two-tier update engine: seamless background OTA soft updates and in-app APK installer
- Hidden adult content toggle unlocked via security keyword

Changed
- Downloads tab groups series titles on top with badge counts and navigation to the new series episode viewer
- Improved player controls layout and bottom navigation bar styling

Fixed
- Google Play Console DEX code optimization warning resolved via R8 minification and resource shrinking
- ProGuard rules configured for React Native and Hermes runtime stability
- Removed deprecated Android edgeToEdgeEnabled property
